extracted.intended_audience: researchers/applicants preparing proposals for the NIH Director's Transformative Research Award (TRA)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for preparing and submitting an application to the NIH Director's Transformative Research Award — a High-Risk, High-Reward program supporting transformative, potentially paradigm-shifting projects. Covers eligibility, expectations about risk and preliminary data, and budget/effort flexibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transformative potential
rubrics_metrics.description: Supports projects that have the potential to create or overturn fundamental paradigms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The award is intended for transformative projects — those that, if successful, could change fundamental understanding or approaches in a field. (Page text: 'have the potential to create or overturn fundamental paradigms.')

rubrics_metrics.name: Inherently risky and untested
rubrics_metrics.description: Projects should be inherently risky and untested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program explicitly targets high-risk projects; risk and lack of prior testing are expected characteristics rather than disqualifying factors. (Page text: 'transformative projects that are inherently risky and untested')

rubrics_metrics.name: Open to all career stages
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants may be at any career stage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The opportunity is available to investigators across career stages (junior through senior). (Page text: 'Open to all career stages')

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligible applicants: individuals or teams
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications may be submitted by individual investigators or teams.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Both single-investigator and multi-investigator/team proposals are permitted. (Page text: 'Open to individuals or teams')

rubrics_metrics.name: No preliminary data required
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants are not required to provide preliminary data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The absence of preliminary data is acceptable and expected for high-risk, novel ideas. (Page text: 'No preliminary data required')

rubrics_metrics.name: Research effort commensurate to project needs
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed research effort should match what the project requires.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Investigators should request effort levels that are appropriate and justified by the scope and needs of the proposed project. (Page text: 'Research effort commensurate to project needs')

rubrics_metrics.name: Flexible budgets
rubrics_metrics.description: Budgeting is flexible to accommodate project needs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program allows flexibility in budget requests to support the nature and scale of transformative projects. (Page text: 'Flexible budgets') See Award Overview for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: May require very large budgets
rubrics_metrics.description: Projects may legitimately require very large budgets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Acknowledges that transformative work sometimes needs substantial resources; applicants may propose very large budgets when justified. (Page text: 'may require very large budgets')

rubrics_metrics.name: No prior approval required for large budget requests
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants do not need prior approval to request large budgets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Large budget requests may be submitted without prior approval, easing administrative barriers for proposing high-cost transformative work. (Page text: 'No prior approval required for large budget requests')
